summary.answer: Absent obitModel or currentIndexModel returns immediately. Chooses entry icon, increments/moves every active line and counts them. Reads current index; when active count exceeds maxElementIndex force-hides that slot. Unless movie-camera bit is set, shows it and marks active. Always advances circular index modulo max+1 and returns true after those guards. Retain the empty moviecam arm and unguarded lines/index operations. Initializes entry id=-1 and forcedToHide=false, registers hide_obituary_entry with the exact helper, attaches five animation/show/move/hide/force-hide function references, then stores lifetime and direction. Controller is unused; registration does not invoke cleanup.
